title: While the Goals are lifted, `enter` opens the hidden first row with no cue on screen.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Raised by the ui in round 1 of ork run ork-20261125-204703-eec0 for S580 (discovered from S580):

While the Goals are lifted, `enter` opens the hidden first row with no cue on screen.
At 80x10 after `home`, the frame shows only Goals lines and no Roadmap row (`roadmap-goals-top-80x10.txt`). `enter` then opens `Item S90` (`enter-lifted-80x10.txt`). The owner cannot see which row is selected. The spec accepts that the cursor row may leave the window (Implement step 3, adj 578), so this is not a fix for S580. A follow-up could have `enter` end the lift first, or show a selected-row cue such as `cursor: S90` in the marker. PLAUSIBLE that this confuses the owner; the behavior itself is CONFIRMED by render.
Importance: 1
Urgency: 1
Effort: 2
